title: Haqiqat taxti
intro: O'zining buyuk donoligi va ulug'vor taxti bilan tanilgan qudratli hukmdor noma'lum manbadan sirli xabar oladi. Bu kutilmagan xabar ularning e'tiqodlari va obro'siga shubha tug'diradi, ularni aql-zakovatini sinovdan o'tkazadigan va oxir-oqibat chuqur ma'naviy uyg'onishga olib keladigan diplomatik safarga olib chiqadi. Ushbu hukmdorning kimligini va ularning butun qirolligini o'zgartirgan voqealarni ochib bera olasizmi?
clues: Men va xalqim ajdodlarimizning yo'llaridan borib, quyoshga sig'inardik.
Qush, yaʼni hupi, menga qudratli rahbardan xat olib kelgan kutilmagan xabarchi edi.
Yuboruvchining donoligini sinash uchun men qimmatbaho sovg'alar yubordim, ammo ular qaytarib berildi, chunki jo'natuvchi Allohdan ancha katta boylikka ega edi.
Men jo'natuvchining saroyiga yetib bormasdan oldin, ulug'vor taxtim mo''jizaviy ravishda ko'z ochib yumguncha u yerga olib kelindi.
Yetib kelganimda, ko'chirilgan taxt menikimi, deb so'rashdi va men: "Go'yo u aynan o'sha taxt", deb javob berdim.
Men katta zalga kirdim, uning polini suv havzasi deb adashtirdim va o'sha hayrat lahzasida olamlarning Parvardigori Allohga o'zimni Sulaymon payg'ambar bilan birga topshirdim.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
